title: Fire Fighting, Seoul, Korea (Nov 1947 reel)
producer: Office of the Chief Signal Officer, U.S. Army
licence: Public domain: US federal government work: filmed by US military personnel as part of their official duties, so under 17 U.S.C. § 105 it is not protected by copyright in the US (public domain). In Korea it is also out of term: the Korean Copyright Act protects films for 70 years from publication, and this footage is from 1947.
licence_notes: NARA's catalog shows the generic 'Restricted - Possibly' copyright flag that it puts on most of this series. The reel is raw Army Signal Corps camera footage (the slates name Army cameramen and units), so it is a federal work. Low risk, but recorded here as-is.
kogl_type: N/A (US federal work, not a Korean 공공저작물)
attribution_required: Not legally required for public-domain works, but recommended (and good practice for the channel):
attribution_text: 영상 출처: 미국 국립문서기록관리청(NARA) 111-ADC-6919 (NAID 20692) / Source: U.S. National Archives, 111-ADC-6919 (NAID 20692)
contents: A large brick building with a domed corner tower burns in central Seoul. Korean firefighters in heavy coats and helmets climb the burning facade and train hoses on the windows, smoke billows over the rooftops of the city, and water arcs into the collapsing roof and dome. NARA does not name the building, so don't caption it with a specific name unless you verify it. Near-silent track.
